provenance.feasibility_note: POS-FEAS-01 is a synthetic CAD observability study (3.38 % seat-region change at 35 deg elevation). It is not a measurement of real-camera accuracy. No accuracy figure should be quoted for this feature until a labelled real-camera test set has been measured.
provenance.scope_note: Seat anchors originate from the saved calibration view. Runtime tracks body_a image features frame-to-frame and transforms the seat markers. This is 2-D image-plane tracking, not general 6-DoF pose estimation. If the view changes too much or tracking confidence is low, markers are hidden and Stage_01/02 position confirmation is paused. Recalibrate after moving the camera or changing camera settings.
provenance.pose_tracking: Body-relative feature tracking from the saved calibration pose; gradual movement is followed frame-to-frame. Large 3-D view changes that cannot be tracked safely result in hidden markers and blocked Stage_01/02 confirmation.
